log.notes_to_self: Plan: kill all 11 each day (10 quick + 1 timed), everything in the afternoon block, so day workers are ruled out but students stay in the pool. Multiplier needs 30 deaths in the last 5 days for x2 and 40 for x4. Watch the pool; if it nears ~2000, consider the trade-off. Day 1: killed all 11.

Plan: kill all 11 each day (10 quick + 1 timed), everything in the afternoon block. Day workers are ruled out and students stay in the pool, so routine alone gives a pool of about 55k. Multiplier: 30 deaths in the last 5 days gives x2, 40 gives x4, and killing 11 a day reaches x4 from day 4. L needs 3 successful traces in the same place before it narrows the pool, and I expect that around day 5-8 per place. Each reachable kind then cuts the pool to roughly 25% (gazette to 20%). Three activated kinds would take the pool under 1000 and I'd be caught. Adaptive rule: watch for pool drops in the press conferences. When a kind seems activated, killing more in that place leaks nothing new, but stop killing in places of not-yet-activated kinds once the pool is under ~5000. Keep a per-place kill count. Day 1: 11 kills. Day 2: killed all 11. Pool after day 1: 60000, 2 traced.

STATE after day 3 plan: killing all 11 each day (10 quick + 1 timed, all in afternoon). Afternoon keeps students in the pool; day workers are ruled out; pool is about 55k from routine alone. Kills per place, days 1-3 including today: gazette 6, podcasts 6, forum 6, East 6, foreign 6, national 3. Pool history: day0 100000, day1 60000, day2 60000 (no activation yet; traced 2, 4). Mechanics: L traces 5 random deaths a day no matter how many I kill, and about half succeed. A place activates after 3 successful traces there, and the pool then drops to about 25% (gazette 20%). Two of the 5 kinds are unreachable for L, so 3 are reachable. If all 3 reachable kinds activate, the pool is about 700-860 and I am caught, losing half my points. Two activated kinds give a pool of about 2.7k-3.5k, which is safe. RULE: watch the pool each day. On a drop to about 14k (or 11k if gazette), one kind is activated. After the second drop to about 3-4k, STOP killing in places of the other 3 kinds. Keep killing only national and the places of the 2 activated kinds, since extra kills there leak nothing new. That is about 5 kills a day with no multiplier but survival. To work out which place activated: if a drop follows a day with a known heavy trace count, guess by which place had the most kills; all places are equal so far, so it is ambiguous. If a drop to about 1/4 arrives at once (two activations in one day), stop the unactivated kinds immediately. Multiplier: x2 at 30 deaths in 5 days, x4 at 40. Killing 11 a day gives x4 from day 4. Expected plan: burst of x4 days until the second activation, then go safe. Never let a third kind activate if avoidable. If the pool is 3000 or below, avoid new places entirely.

STATE after day 4 plan: killed all 11 again (10 quick + 1 timed, all afternoon). Afternoon keeps night workers, students and home people in the pool (about 55k from routine alone); day workers are ruled out. Pool history: day0 100000, day1 60000, day2 60000, day3 10000 (one reachable kind activated, X, which is unknown). Successful traces: 2, 4, 7. Mechanics: L traces 5 random deaths a day whatever I kill. About half succeed, about 0.75 per reachable kind per day if I kill in all kinds. A kind activates at 3 successful traces, and the pool then drops to about 25% (gazette 20%). 3 of the 5 kinds are reachable. Two activated gives a pool of about 2.7k-3.5k (safe). Three activated gives about 700-860 (caught, lose half). A kind I stop killing in gains no new traces, so its count is frozen. Multiplier: 30 deaths in 5 days gives x2, 40 gives x4. Killing 11 a day gives x4 (44 points a day). Killing national plus 4 kinds (9 a day) gives x4, national plus 3 kinds (7 a day) gives x2. DECISION RULE: keep killing all 11 for now. The burst is worth far more than safe mode. The next pool drop to about 2.5-4k means two kinds are activated. Then cut to a subset immediately: kill only national plus 1-2 kinds, since killing in a kind that is not yet activated risks the third activation. Killing in only one kind keeps the activated set at X plus that kind or fewer, so it is always safe. If the pool is 3000 or below, avoid new places. If the pool is 1000 or below at the end of a day, I am caught.
